paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Domain distribution of our annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set (covering 12 domains in total).
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the domain distribution of the annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set, displaying a total of 12 distinct categories. The largest segment, positioned at the top right, is "AI/NLP Research" in blue at 24.3%. Continuing clockwise, the chart includes "Business" in red (5.9%), "Geography" in golden yellow (2.7%), "Math" in dark green (1.2%), "Game&Anime" in dark orange (8.2%), "Econ. & Fin." in turquoise (18.4%), "Science" in light blue (6.7%), "Law" in salmon (5.1%), "History" in yellow (8.2%), "Med & Health" in light green (6.7%), "Pet & Animal" in light orange (5.5%), and "Daily Life" in light cyan (7.1%). The chart lacks a separate legend and internal percentage labels; rather, the category names and their corresponding percentages are positioned outside the pie on the left and right sides, connected to their respective slices by thin grey leader lines. None of the slices are visually emphasized through exploding or offsetting, and the segments do not appear to be arranged in a strict ascending or descending size-based order.
